video.title: Ai Corporate Infographic Poc Sales Data

scenes.narration: Welcome to our comprehensive performance review for fiscal year 2026. Today, we examine twelve months of operational data across four core regions, tracking two flagship product lines: Industrial Motors and Pumps. By evaluating revenue, targets, and customer growth, we uncover key performance drivers shaping our market trajectory.
scenes.title: Corporate Performance Overview
scenes.subtitle: Jan-Dec 2026: Regional & Product Analysis

scenes.narration: Leading the charge is the West region, our undisputed powerhouse. Throughout 2026, the West consistently over-delivered on both Industrial Motors and Pumps. By December, Industrial Motors in the West surpassed targets by 1.7 Crores, while customer acquisition scaled rapidly to 157 accounts, setting the benchmark for the entire enterprise.
scenes.title: West Region Performance (Dec 2026)

scenes.narration: Moving to the South, we see a tale of two distinct product trajectories. Industrial Motors experienced phenomenal growth, steadily climbing to 10.5 Crores by year-end and outperforming targets. Meanwhile, Pumps maintained a stable, reliable trajectory, hovering just shy of targets with exceptional consistency.
scenes.title: South Region Growth (Dec 2026)

scenes.narration: The East region demonstrated remarkable resilience and stabilization. While Industrial Motors started the year with minor negative variances, targeted strategic shifts paid off, pushing achievement past 101% by December. Pumps similarly closed the gap, maintaining steady alignment with regional forecasts.
scenes.title: East Region Stabilization

scenes.narration: In contrast, the North region faced notable headwinds throughout 2026. Despite steady customer growth—reaching 101 accounts for Industrial Motors by December—both product lines experienced persistent negative variances, with achievement percentages lagging between 92 and 96 percent against aggressive targets.
scenes.title: North Region Headwinds (Dec 2026)

scenes.narration: Comparing our two core product lines, Industrial Motors proved to be the primary catalyst for revenue growth and positive variance, particularly in the West and South. Pumps, though operating on slightly tighter margins and minor negative variances in the North and East, provided a solid, predictable foundation of recurring customer demand.
scenes.title: Product Comparison: Motors vs Pumps

scenes.narration: As we close out 2026, the data provides a clear roadmap for the future. We must replicate the successful sales and scaling strategies of the West region across the board, while deploying targeted operational interventions in the North to close the target gap. Armed with these insights, we are primed for accelerated success in the year ahead.
